base_image_note: nicholasfreitas/cuda_micromamba_base:cuda12.2.0-base-ubuntu22.04-micromamba is present locally and provides CUDA 12.2 runtime with Micromamba 2.2.0 on Ubuntu 22.04.
build_gotchas: Apptainer mounts images read-only under --containall, so JAX/XLA compilation cache, HuggingFace, Triton, and Matplotlib caches must be pointed to /tmp.
mksquashfs on this host must be invoked with --mksquashfs-args '-mem 512M -processors 2' to prevent OOM killer under Slurm cgroups.
CUDA 12 driver (535.309.01) matches jax[cuda12] and cuequivariance-ops-cu12. Using cuda12 guarantees forward and backward compatibility across CUDA 12 and CUDA 13 host drivers.
bindcraft CLI entrypoint shim must be placed on PATH in both /opt/conda/envs/app/bin/bindcraft and /usr/local/bin/bindcraft to avoid argument swallowing by shell wrappers.

AlphaFold parameters must be baked into the image at /app/models/alphafold and symlinked into /app/bindcraft/bindcraft/weights/alphafold with BINDCRAFT_AF2_PARAMS set so offline compute nodes need no internet.

validation.target: Design 1 short binder against human PD-L1 (hPDL1) target with JAX AlphaFold and ProteinMPNN end-to-end pipeline.
